Rift Bomber · local versus

Arena rules

Controls

P1 · WASD
Move your selected champion. Space always plants the arena bomb.
Katarina · Q/F/E/R
Bouncing Blade, Preparation, Shunpo and Death Lotus. F replaces W because W is forward movement.
Voracity
Walk over a grounded dagger to spin, slash nearby targets and heavily reduce Shunpo’s cooldown.
Ziggs · Q/Shift
Q plants a bomb and Left Shift triggers Satchel burst.
P2 · Arrows
Move Red Ziggs. Enter or Numpad 0 plants a bomb; Right Shift triggers Satchel burst.
Solo play
The CPU controls Red until Player 2 presses an arrow key or Enter.
M
Mute or restore the original soundtrack.
P
Pause the game and audio clock.
H
Open or close this guide.

Blast doctrine

  • Bombs erupt in four straight lanes. Stone blocks stop every blast.
  • Break Hextech crates to uncover extra bombs, blast range, movement speed, and shields.
  • Power-up layouts are mirrored every round, so both corners receive equal opportunities.
  • One blast can trigger another bomb. Every explosion—including your own—can eliminate you.
  • Win three rounds before the rival. A double knockout replays the round without a point.

The symphony system

“Welcome to the Rift” is a four-minute, 128 BPM soundtrack synthesized live in your browser. Its eight sections share one sample-accurate clock with bomb glow, interface meters, post-processing, enemy aggression, and camera impact. No audio file is streamed or embedded.

Classic arena contract

Permanent stone pillars never break. Crates stop a blast and disappear after one hit. The bomber who plants a bomb may leave its tile once; stepping back into it is blocked.

Katarina’s assassination route

Q leaves a dagger behind its target. F drops another dagger and grants movement speed. E blinks to the nearest dagger or rival; picking up that dagger triggers Voracity. R only channels when Red Ziggs is close enough, and movement stops during the blade storm.
